description: From the 2026-08-07 bookkeeping pass: ControlDict has 13 fields and 10 are inert -- adjustTimeStep, maxCo, and all write-control fields are read by NOTHING. Their doc comments now say so, but inert config is a user trap: a case author sets maxCo and believes the timestep is Courant-limited when it is not. Either implement adaptive stepping + write control (ties into the real-time epic op-wxx's executive work and op-52t) or remove the fields until they act. Also note the crate CLAUDE.md previously mandated calling adjust_delta_t(co_max, dt_max), a method that does not exist (doc fixed 2026-08-07); if adaptive stepping lands, that is the natural name.
title: appbuilder: wire or delete the 10 inert ControlDict fields

description:
The classic HTGR process-heat application and the highest-temperature duty in the flowsheet, so it is the interesting stress case for the temperature match.

SCOPE: wire crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs/src/reactors/gibbs_reactor.rs to a reforming feed, with the reformer duty supplied by the nuclear process heater rather than by burning fuel gas. Report approach to equilibrium, methane conversion and hydrogen yield as functions of temperature, pressure and steam-to-carbon ratio.

V&V per the workspace rule: validate the equilibrium composition against published equilibrium data or an independent equilibrium calculation, and record the actual numbers with tolerances in the test doc comment. Do not report a yield that was not produced by running the model.

Depends on the reformer being reachable at the available helium outlet temperature — see op-1z3o.1.
title: refinery: steam-methane reformer as a Gibbs equilibrium block for hydrogen

description:
OpenFOAM (C++) Rust translation. Dependents to update: openfoam-turbulence-
lib, openfoam-appbuilder-lib (and any others with a path dep on openfoam-
basic-lib). Highest fan-in of the OpenFOAM set — rename it first or
coordinate.

Naming update (user, 2026-07-10): target name is outram-foam-basic-lib,
NOT outram-park-fork-openfoam-basic-lib as originally scoped in this epic
(op-ahi) — the OpenFOAM-derived crates get their own outram-foam- prefix
instead of the general outram-park-fork- prefix used by the epic's other
children (njoy/openmc/dwsim). See the note added on the op-ahi epic.

New requirement: when this rename lands, add an explicit disambiguation
note in this crate's README.md/docs — "this is OUTRAM PARK's Rust fork of
OpenFOAM, not the official ESI/OpenCFD OpenFOAM(R) software" — following
the disclaimer pattern already established in the root TRADEMARKS.md
(OpenFOAM(R) section). TRADEMARKS.md itself currently says
`outram-park-openfoam-fork-*` (a third, different spelling from either the
current name or the new outram-foam-* target) and needs to be updated to
match whatever name is actually chosen, in the same pass.

Status: book-keeping only, not started (per epic rule: do not execute).
title: Rename openfoam-basic-lib -> outram-foam-basic-lib
